title: Ya Imam-e-Reza
body:
Ya Imam-e-Reza
Ya Imame Reza x 4
<<MINI>>
Aye garibul watan ya Imame Reza x 2
<<DIVIDER>>
Warise bekafan ya Imame Reza.
<<MINI>>
Aye garibul watan ya Imame Reza x 2
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Haye sitam zeher ka dono sehkar gaye
Bilyaqeen laadle dono zehra ke the
Ek imame hasan ya Imame Reza
2. Shahe karbobala se ye nisbat teri
<<DIVIDER>>
Unke laashe pe bhi tere laashe pe bhi
Rona paayi behen ya imame Reza
3. Tere baba ka tabut uthna saka
Pool pe baghdad ke laasha rakkha raha
<<DIVIDER>>
Tha kafan payraahan ya imame Reza
4. Jo chubhan tere seene me thi zeher ki
Abbhi mehsoos karte hai wo maatami
Apne dil me chubhan ya imame Reza
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Aye bine sayyada aye bine murtaza
Mushkilo me hame hai tera aasra
Badshahe zaman ya imame Reza
6. Haqqe ajdaad ko tujse chhina gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye madina tera tujse chhudwa diya
Aye aseere mahan ya Imame Reza
7. Jaaye salmaano meesum khorasan me
Tere rauze pe jaaker ye nauha padhe
<<DIVIDER>>
Dede izne sukhan ya imame Reza
